blocks.prompt: 3 (a) Figure 7.11 is the velocity-time graph of Aslam's motion as he runs along a straight track. For the first 5 seconds, he accelerates uniformly from rest to a velocity of 8 m/s. He then maintains this velocity for a further 8 seconds. Find: The rate at which Aslam accelerates.
blocks.explanation:
The rate of acceleration is the slope of the velocity-time graph.
Given: from rest (0 m/s) to 8 m/s uniformly in 5 s.
Plan: slope of OA, or v = u + at.
steps:
Given: \(u = 0\), \(v = 8\) m/s after \(t = 5\) s, uniform acceleration.
To find: the acceleration.
Method: on a velocity-time graph the slope \(dv/dt\) is the acceleration (7.1.5). Uniform acceleration gives the straight line OA.

Slope of OA
\[a = \dfrac{8 - 0}{5 - 0}\]
\[= \dfrac{8}{5} = 1.6\text{ m/s}^2\]
Why: slope = change of velocity divided by change of time.

Check with \(v = u + at\)
\[0 + 1.6 \times 5 = 8 \;\checkmark\]
Why: the first equation of motion must give back the final velocity 8 m/s.

blocks.prompt: 3 (b) Figure 7.11 is the velocity-time graph of Aslam's motion as he runs along a straight track. For the first 5 seconds, he accelerates uniformly from rest to a velocity of 8 m/s. He then maintains this velocity for a further 8 seconds. Find: The displacement from the starting point of Aslam after 13 seconds.
blocks.explanation:
Displacement is the area under the velocity-time graph.
Given: the graph O(0, 0), A(5, 8), B(13, 8), C(13, 0).
Plan: area of trapezium OABC, as in Example 5.
steps:
Given: corner points O(0, 0), A(5, 8), B(13, 8), C(13, 0) and D(5, 0).
To find: the displacement after 13 s.
Method: displacement = area under the velocity-time graph from \(t = 0\) to \(t = 13\) (7.1.5). The region OABC is a trapezium: \(\frac{1}{2}(a + b)h\).

Sides of the trapezium
\[|OC| = 13,\quad |AB| = 13 - 5 = 8\]
\[h = 8\]
Why: OC and AB are the parallel sides; the height is the constant velocity 8 m/s.

Area
\[x = \dfrac{1}{2}(13 + 8) \times 8\]
\[= 84\text{ m}\]
Why: area of a trapezium = half the sum of the parallel sides times the distance between them.

Check: triangle plus rectangle
\[\tfrac{1}{2}(5)(8) + 8 \times 8\]
\[= 20 + 64 = 84 \;\checkmark\]
Why: the trapezium is the triangle OAD (speeding up) plus the rectangle DABC (steady running).
